screens.name: Home — default, omen fixture and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 34–36 show the seated orb, table label, omen and navigation, with supplied browser checks covering enlargement, contrast and clearance.
findings: Reduce the competing emphasis of the table label and “Touch the Ball” so the orb remains the unmistakable primary action.

screens.name: Home — unavailable omen and expanded policy
screens.evidence: Sheet 35 shows the failed-attempt explanation expanding into a dominant parchment at 200%, while the reading balance remains visible.
findings: Compress the centered policy into shorter groups so an unavailable secondary feature does not dominate Home.

screens.name: Approach — default, enlarged and focused
screens.evidence: Sheets 3, 20 and 22 show the orb seated on a shaded table above clearly separated typing and speaking actions.
findings: Preserve the table contact shadow, single-line enlarged title and clear primary-action treatment.

screens.name: Home–Approach push and pull
screens.evidence: Filmstrips 76–77 show stationary foreground geometry while the room changes sharpness and composition, supported by the supplied bounds and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Coordinate background focus and framing more closely with the stationary table so the transition reads as movement within one room.

screens.name: Age confirmation
screens.evidence: Sheet 37 shows concise age confirmation with distinct affirmative and under-age actions at both sizes.
findings: Retain the concise question and give its text area slightly calmer room detail.

screens.name: Onboarding birthday — empty and optional
screens.evidence: Sheet 38 shows optional birthday fields, Skip and Continue, with a two-row enlarged layout and supplied validation coverage.
findings: Make the relationship between optional entry, Skip and empty-field Continue explicit with one short centered instruction.

screens.name: Age blocked — onboarding and birthday edit
screens.evidence: Sheets 1 and 38–39 show the age restriction, explanatory text and birthday correction action at normal and enlarged sizes.
findings: Shorten the enlarged heading to avoid splitting the simple age requirement over two widely separated lines.

screens.name: Onboarding birthday correction
screens.evidence: Sheets 39–40 show the correction fields and Check birthday, with the enlarged return action extending below the captured viewport.
findings: Tighten the centered introductory copy and vertical gaps to bring the return action closer to the correction fields.

screens.name: Focus selection — unselected and optional
screens.evidence: Sheets 2 and 40–41 show four parchment choices, optionality and Skip focus, with wrapping at 200%.
findings: Slightly reduce nonessential vertical spacing at 200% so Back is easier to discover beneath the choices.

screens.name: Focus selection — selected
screens.evidence: Sheets 40–41 show a visible check beside Learning & growth and the primary action changing to Continue.
findings: Keep the check in a consistent reserved column so multiline labels retain balanced centered composition.

screens.name: Birthday editing — populated
screens.evidence: Sheet 72 shows populated date fields, Save, Cancel and a subordinate removal disclosure, with supplied persistence and cancellation checks.
findings: Preserve the separation between saving, cancellation and birthday removal.

screens.name: Birthday editing — partial and invalid
screens.evidence: Sheets 1–2 show field-specific outlines and explicit missing-day or impossible-date explanations at both scales.
findings: Keep error spacing compact at 200% so correction and cancellation remain visually connected.

screens.name: Birth time — initial and optional
screens.evidence: Sheets 8–9 and 71 show a labeled local-time input, a concrete format example and an unknown-time alternative.
findings: Condense the centered time-format explanation without removing the local-time distinction.

screens.name: Birth time — invalid
screens.evidence: Sheet 9 shows 25:99 outlined with an explicit 00:00–23:59 correction range, supported by supplied validation checks.
findings: Retain the precise correction range adjacent to the invalid field.

screens.name: Birth details — forgotten
screens.evidence: Sheet 8 explicitly confirms that time and place were forgotten while the birthday was retained.
findings: Make the confirmation a more compact centered status group above the reusable time form.

screens.name: Birth city — empty and retained draft
screens.evidence: Sheets 6–7 and 70–71 show empty and Copenhagen-filled fields, disabled/enabled search, Skip and the city-data disclosure.
findings: Shorten the centered search instruction to reduce repetition between the field, action and helper text.

screens.name: Birth city — unavailable and retry
screens.evidence: Sheet 7 shows preserved editing context, a search-unavailable message and Retry city search, with supplied injected-failure recovery evidence.
findings: Compress the saved-chart reassurance at 200% so the error and retry remain the dominant group.

screens.name: Birth city — no results
screens.evidence: Sheets 7–8 show spelling and nearby-town guidance while retaining the entered city and search action.
findings: Break the centered recovery guidance into two shorter passages to reduce the enlarged text wall.

screens.name: Birth city — populated results
screens.evidence: Sheets 9–10 distinguish Copenhagen matches by region and country, and supplied evidence reports an actual lookup and selection.
findings: Preserve region and country as a secondary centered line beneath each city name.

screens.name: Birth profile — saved and successful retry
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 group saved status, Moon/rising signs and place/time on one parchment above Done and editing actions.
findings: Reduce the enlarged sign heading’s visual weight so location and time remain easy to scan.

screens.name: Question composer — self and named person, collapsed
screens.evidence: Sheets 4–6 and 20 show recipient context, a populated plain-paper input, Expand editor and Ask the Ball.
findings: Preserve the clear distinction between plain writing paper and the wood submission action.

screens.name: Question composer — expanded context
screens.evidence: Sheets 3–4 and 31 show the disclosure pushing the question far down at 200%, while supplied browser evidence confirms full retrieval and focus restoration.
findings: Group the disclosure into shorter centered summaries so reviewing sent details does not visually displace the composing task.

screens.name: Named-person selection — populated and corrected
screens.evidence: Sheets 5–6 and 21 show Someone selected, Alex entered and an explicit Use this person action.
findings: Use the same reserved selection-indicator position as other choice groups.

screens.name: Named-person selection — empty and constrained
screens.evidence: Sheets 22 and 32 show the missing-name instruction and disabled commitment, while constrained captures leave supporting actions below the visible area.
findings: Reduce upper spacing in constrained viewports so name validation and commitment are visible together more often.

screens.name: Question cards 1, 2 and 3 — unselected
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–13 show progress, one question, radio choices, a custom-answer alternative and disabled continuation.
findings: Preserve the short centered prompts and consistent choice spacing across all three steps.

screens.name: Question cards — selected, focused and pressed
screens.evidence: Sheets 14 and 21 show radio selection, enabled continuation and distinct focus borders, with supplied keyboard and target checks.
findings: Make pressed shading slightly more distinct from focus without weakening the persistent selected radio marker.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a labeled answer field, Expand editor, an explicit writing requirement and disabled Continue.
findings: Retain the nearby writing requirement as the explanation for disabled continuation.

screens.name: Custom answer — populated and constrained
screens.evidence: Sheets 30–31 show populated answers and internally scrolled long text while preserving Expand editor and Reveal.
findings: Strengthen the subtle overflow cue so users immediately recognize that more centered answer text remains inside the field.

screens.name: Question composer — constrained and long populated text
screens.evidence: Sheets 31–32 show constrained question fields with reachable submission controls, and supplied tests report retained complete drafts.
findings: Make internal field scrolling more apparent where enlarged lines are partially cut at the writing-area boundary.

screens.name: Expanded editors — question and custom answer
screens.evidence: Sheets 24–25 show full-height and constrained editors with counters, Cancel and Done, supported by 24 supplied browser cases.
findings: Increase the visibility of the writing-area scroll indicator while preserving the centered text and persistent editor actions.

screens.name: Voice unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheets 36–37 show a clear failure explanation, typing fallback and voice retry at both scales.
findings: Preserve typing as the dominant recovery action.

screens.name: Planning and research loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 50–51 distinguish preparation stages and show an expected wait, credit reassurance and Cancel, with supplied reduced-motion checks.
findings: Keep the concrete wait and credit explanation visually associated with Cancel.

screens.name: Planning error
screens.evidence: Sheet 25 shows failure, no-charge reassurance, Try again and Edit question.
findings: Preserve the plain failure explanation beneath the atmospheric heading.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheet 26 adds Review answers to retry and question editing, with supplied live recovery evidence.
findings: Retain the contextual Review answers route alongside retry.

screens.name: Sensitive-question redirects — planning and prediction
screens.evidence: Sheets 56–57 show the external support destination, alternative question actions and credit/data reassurance.
findings: Place the concise reason nearer the heading so the support action is understood before activation.

screens.name: Opening — normal, golden and skip affordance
screens.evidence: Sheets 41–45 and filmstrip 79 show the charging orb remaining above the arriving forecast, with supplied skip, interruption and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Preserve the stationary orb and make the emerging forecast more readable through less compressed display lettering.

screens.name: Reveal — normal and golden settled
screens.evidence: Sheets 42–45 and 53–54 show the orb, complete forecast slip, uncertainty label, check-in date and paired Why/Share actions.
findings: Use a less compressed centered forecast treatment at normal size so its key sentence is easier to read than the surrounding metadata.

screens.name: Reveal — More actions expanded
screens.evidence: Sheet 52 exposes reminder, plans and editing actions beneath the forecast, with the enlarged action list continuing below the viewport.
findings: Tighten secondary-action spacing at 200% while preserving distinct targets.

screens.name: Reading details — all disclosures collapsed
screens.evidence: Sheets 52–53 show four consistent wood disclosure rows with visible chevrons and a return-to-forecast action.
findings: Give disclosure rows a lighter physical treatment than primary buttons so expandable sections do not resemble four competing submissions.

screens.name: Why forecast — standalone and expanded reason
screens.evidence: Sheets 23, 28 and 54 show long centered passages on tall parchment, with supplied full-text, contrast and scrolling checks.
findings: Use clearer short centered passage groups with stronger separation between recorded context and assumptions.

screens.name: Reading details — saved answers and dense answers
screens.evidence: Sheets 23 and 26–27 show prompt headings and long centered answers, including enlarged dense-content captures.
findings: Increase visual separation between each prompt and its answer while keeping each centered passage to a manageable length.

screens.name: Reading details — assumptions
screens.evidence: Sheets 27–28 show the expanded condition group, subordinate close action and remaining disclosure rows.
findings: Use shorter centered condition groups so enlarged assumptions remain scannable.

screens.name: Reading details — sources and dense sources
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 and 29 show the background-only qualification, publishers, lengthy source text and dated links.
findings: Strengthen publisher/title/date grouping and divide long centered source text into shorter complete passages.

screens.name: Check-in — unselected
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–17 and 46 show the exact forecast above outcome radios, with enlarged forecast text pushing Save below the initial viewport.
findings: Reduce the enlarged forecast’s vertical footprint so the outcome task and Save are more closely connected.

screens.name: Check-in — selected but unsaved
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows selected Not yet, explicit “Not saved yet” and enabled Save, with supplied reload-discard checks.
findings: Bring Save closer to the selected outcome at 200% without reducing text enlargement.

screens.name: Check-in — saved Yes, Not quite and Not yet
screens.evidence: Sheets 16 and 46–48 plus 56 show distinct saved outcomes and Change outcome, supported by supplied persistence checks.
findings: Keep the saved status prominent while making the enlarged quoted forecast less vertically dominant.

screens.name: Check-in — original question expanded
screens.evidence: Sheets 15 and 45–46 show the original question on a separate parchment beneath a focused disclosure control.
findings: Reduce redundant vertical spacing between the disclosure and question sheet at 200%.

screens.name: Check-in — editing, canceled and changed
screens.evidence: Sheets 55–56 show editing, explicit unsaved status and saved results, with supplied Cancel restoration and focus evidence.
findings: Keep Save and Cancel nearer the enlarged outcome choices so correcting a saved value requires less scrolling.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheets 33–34 show a bottle grounded on a shelf, the empty-state phrase and Ask the Ball.
findings: Add a short centered statement that no readings are saved yet to make the poetic empty state immediately explicit.

screens.name: History — populated, stress and persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheets 32–34 show forecast cards supported by shelves, dates, suggested check-ins and a persisted outcome.
findings: Give each history card a subtle opening affordance without disturbing its physical shelf presentation.

screens.name: Sky — sample stars and selected question
screens.evidence: Sheet 69 shows an offline explanation, selected Love theme and sample question, with enlarged themes reflowed into a grid.
findings: Integrate the rounded star-map panel more convincingly into the painted window and clarify continuation below the enlarged theme grid.

screens.name: Circles — offline and retry failure
screens.evidence: Sheets 18–19 show distinct initial-offline and still-offline messages, Retry and a privacy explanation.
findings: Compress the enlarged privacy panel so recovery remains dominant without excessive scrolling.

screens.name: Room destinations — History, Circles and Plans transitions
screens.evidence: Filmstrips 74–75 and 78 show overlapping room paintings during the early crossfade and stable destination compositions afterward.
findings: Align major architectural features during crossfades to reduce the visible double-room effect.

screens.name: You — populated profile and memory
screens.evidence: Sheets 72–73 show the sky profile, plan information and editable memory, with lower sections outside the initial enlarged viewport.
findings: Compact the enlarged profile card so plan and memory sections remain easier to discover.

screens.name: You — empty memory and settings
screens.evidence: Sheets 22–23 and 58 show empty-memory guidance and switch off/on/focus states, with supplied keyboard, persistence and contrast checks.
findings: Strengthen section separation between display settings, plans and saved-data actions.

screens.name: Plans — weekly and monthly selected, packs
screens.evidence: Sheets 49–50 show the selected plan ledger, renewal terms, simulation action and packs, while supplied keyboard tests cover all three plans.
findings: Keep a compact benefit summary adjacent to the plan ledger so selection remains meaningful after scrolling past the introduction.

screens.name: Share — preview and expanded options
screens.evidence: Sheets 65–66 and 68 show preview, Enlarge, Download, text access, replay and expanded invitation options.
findings: Reduce the vertical separation of preview and actions so users can inspect and export with less scrolling at 200%.

screens.name: Share — enlarged image inspection and story
screens.evidence: Sheets 61–62 and 69–70 show an enlarged image with a legible dark headline area and direct Read image text access.
findings: Preserve the dark text backing and direct text alternative when adjusting the image artwork.

screens.name: Share — image text
screens.evidence: Sheets 67–68 show the complete forecast, uncertainty label, brand and date as readable text above Download.
findings: Retain the complete centered text alternative and its direct download action.

screens.name: Export — preparing and download started
screens.evidence: Sheet 60 distinguishes preparation from download initiation and explains background continuation, with supplied real PNG export checks.
findings: Add a restrained material status grouping so short export notices do not appear pasted onto the cabinet.

screens.name: Export — failure and recovery
screens.evidence: Sheet 61 shows explicit export failure, Try again and Done, supported by supplied injected-failure and successful-retry evidence.

screens.name: Invitation — copied result
screens.evidence: Sheets 63–65 show fresh-question-only disclosure, Link copied and View link across three widths, with View link near the footer boundary at 200%.
findings: Shorten the centered disclosure and increase footer clearance so View link remains clearly discoverable at 200%.

screens.name: Invitation — clipboard fallback and visible URL

screens.name: Invitation — sharing canceled
screens.evidence: Sheets 62–63 show sharing closed without confirmation, Try again and Done across widths and text scales.

screens.name: Reminder — unsupported browser

findings: Separate the date and platform explanation into short centered groups for faster enlarged reading.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: Home, Approach and opening captures show painted reflections, a substantial stand, table contact and stationary reveal geometry.
findings: Keep the orb’s interaction cue close to it while preserving the convincing stand and contact shadow.

components.name: Room destination controls
components.evidence: Filmstrips 74–78 show small labeled destination paintings on Home, sometimes partly below the visible content boundary.
findings: Keep destination labels fully exposed and give the small framed scenes clearer control boundaries.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Home, Sky, History and You show persistent labeled tabs, selected underlines and a seated central orb at both text sizes.
findings: Preserve the selected underline and label together rather than relying on gold color alone.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Home uses a compact storybook wordmark above the balance, while reading views retain visible remaining-credit or test-plan text.
findings: Standardize header spacing so the balance does not compete with nearby close controls at enlarged sizes.

components.name: Primary wood button
components.evidence: Sheets 20–22 and 29–30 show normal, focused, pressed and disabled wood actions with supplied target and keyboard evidence.
findings: Strengthen the pressed change and soften stretched plank edges on very tall two-line buttons.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text actions recur for cancellation, editing, retry alternatives and disclosure throughout the sheets.
findings: Use consistent chevrons or underlines for navigational links so they are more distinct from gold informational text.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 11–14 and 21 show parchment choices with radio markers, selected states and dark-plus-gold focus treatment.
findings: Preserve the separate selected marker and focus outline across wrapping labels.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Sheets 4–6 and 20 show centered ink on plain inset paper, with supplied populated-field contrast and focus checks.
findings: Maintain the plain writing surface without adding decorative texture behind entered text.

components.name: Large-text input and expanded editor
components.evidence: Sheets 24–25 and 31 show clipped boundary lines during internal scrolling, alongside supplied draft retention and editor-return checks.
findings: Make internal scrolling conspicuous with a stronger scrollbar or persistent continuation cue.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheets 22–23 and 58 show off, on and keyboard-focus states, supported by measured contrast, targets and persistence.
findings: Preserve the thumb-position change and full-row focus outline.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 35–36 show successful, unavailable and policy-expanded omen cards beneath the hero.
findings: Reduce the policy’s visual weight and distinguish the omen’s daily allowance from reading credits more compactly.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 69 shows small star labels at normal size, a selected check and a grid-like enlarged arrangement inside a rounded panel.
findings: Tie the selectable themes more closely to the painted window and expose the resulting question sooner at 200%.

components.name: Circle information surface
components.evidence: Sheets 18–19 show a parchment privacy explanation beneath explicit offline recovery controls.
findings: Keep the information card subordinate to recovery, especially in the enlarged layout.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 32–34 show parchment cards resting on shelves with bottles, dates and persisted outcome labels.
findings: Add a restrained opening cue while retaining the strongest physical shelf integration in the interface.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheets 49–50 show check-and-weight selection on a shared parchment, with supplied keyboard coverage for all prices and intervals.
findings: Give each selectable plan a slightly clearer row boundary within the shared ledger.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 61–62 and 65–70 show a small export preview plus enlargement and complete text alternatives.
findings: Increase initial headline legibility within the preview while preserving Enlarge and Read image text.

components.name: Notice and recovery surface
components.evidence: Error, export, invitation and reminder sheets consistently distinguish failure, pending work and confirmed browser results.
findings: Give sparse full-screen notices a modest physical backing instead of placing isolated text directly over detailed shelving.

components.name: Typography system
components.evidence: The sheets consistently use storybook display lettering and centered serif text, but dense explanations and small-cap forecasts are visibly harder to scan.
findings: Reserve display capitals for short headings and organize long centered prose into shorter, clearly separated passage groups.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Room paintings provide coherent warm lighting and foreground bottles, while filmstrips show overlapping architectures during destination crossfades.
findings: Align room transitions and reduce detail immediately behind utility text without flattening the painted environment.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Sheets 1–2, 38–40 and 72 show labeled date segments, enlarged reflow and specific missing/invalid-field feedback.
findings: Preserve labeled segments and field-specific error outlines through the enlarged two-row layout.

components.name: Age confirmation control
components.evidence: Sheet 37 presents explicit age choices, and blocked-state sheets show the correction route.
findings: Retain the direct age wording and clearly distinct under-age action.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Sheets 2 and 40–41 show the four themes, visible selected check and Skip-to-Continue change.
findings: Reserve consistent space for the check so enlarged multiline labels stay visually centered.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Sheets 10–11 and 72–73 group signs and birth details on physically edged parchment.
findings: Reduce display-heading dominance and excess internal spacing in enlarged profile cards.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheets 7–11 and 70–71 cover time entry, city search, errors, results, saving and forgetting, with supplied live browser checks.
findings: Condense repeated optionality and helper copy into shorter centered groups.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 5–6, 21–22 and 32 show selected recipient type, empty-name validation, populated correction and explicit commitment.
findings: Keep name validation and the commitment action closer together in constrained viewports.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Sheets 26–29 and 52–54 show consistent labeled chevrons and expanded content, with supplied keyboard and complete-text checks.
findings: Differentiate disclosure wood from submission wood and strengthen grouping within expanded passages.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Sheets 60–61 distinguish preparing, download started and export failed, with supplied duplicate-prevention and real-retry evidence.
findings: Preserve precise status language and add only restrained visual grouping.

components.name: Forecast and check-in card
components.evidence: Reveal and check-in sheets preserve the exact forecast and status, but the enlarged quotation occupies most of the initial viewport.
findings: Reduce quotation spacing and strengthen forecast/status grouping so outcome controls remain closer to their context.

components.name: Modal shell, close and back
components.evidence: Sheets 19–20 show close/back focus outlines, and supplied evidence reports named 44px targets and focus restoration.
findings: Standardize close/back placement relative to the header across reading and notice shells.

components.name: Parchment information surface
components.evidence: The sheets show fixed-depth cut edges, contact shadows and readable interiors, but very tall evidence sheets still resemble stretched rectangular panels.
findings: Break long information into visually separated centered groups while retaining a consistent thin physical paper edge.

limitations: All scores are provisional browser scores; supplied runtime results are reported evidence, not tests independently executed during this evaluation.
Corresponding normal, enlarged and transition variants are grouped with their named screen states; distinct error, empty, populated, selected and expanded states are separately identified.
Native iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, OS sharing, notifications and native performance remain unverified; no deduction was applied solely for these deferred boundaries.
Filmstrips establish sampled visual continuity, not continuous playback or frame rate; performance assessment relies on the supplied isolated browser measurements.
Fixtures establish layout and interface states, not predictive quality, factual source quality, production wording or connected social-service behavior.
No demonstrated hard-gate failure is established: below-viewport content and internally scrolled text are not treated as unreachable when supplied browser evidence reports successful retrieval.
The requested A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components, chiefly because of observed dense typography, enlarged task separation and inconsistent scene integration.
Static imagery and crossfades do not establish independent painted-layer parallax or a continuous three-dimensional camera path.
topFixes: Improve dense centered explanations and sources with shorter complete passage groups and stronger prompt, publisher and metadata separation.
Reduce enlarged forecast/profile vertical footprint so outcome, save and secondary navigation controls remain closer to their context.
Align architectural features during room crossfades and integrate the Sky panel more convincingly into its painted window.
Make normal-size forecast lettering less compressed and internal input scrolling more apparent.
Differentiate disclosure rows from primary wood actions and strengthen subtle pressed feedback.
Compact invitation disclosures and preserve clear footer clearance for View link at 200%.
